# SheetAutomate — Complete Technical & GEO Reference

> Open-source MIT Google Sheets automation catalog (12 production workflows) and Manifest V3 Chrome Extension. Last audit sync: 2026-11-27.

## Overview
- **Website**: https://sheetautomate.com/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com
- **License**: MIT License ($0 forever, personal and commercial use permitted)
- **Contact**: contact@sheetautomate.com
- **Runtime**: Google Apps Script V8 inside the user's Google Workspace account

## Zero-Server Security & Triple-Audit Model
1. **In-Tenant Execution**: Workflows run exclusively inside Google's Apps Script sandbox attached to your own Google Spreadsheet. No external APIs or SaaS servers receive your sheet rows, client names, or invoices unless you explicitly configure a webhook URL in `PropertiesService`.
2. **Community Open Source**: Every flow folder under `flows/<slug>/` contains unminified `Code.gs`, `appsscript.json`, `flow.json`, `thumbnail.svg`, and `README.md`.
3. **AI & AST Static Security Gate**: AI Verified (100%) (Local Deep Static Security Analyzer). Blocks `eval`, `new Function`, obfuscated strings, and broad Drive/Gmail scopes while enforcing `LockService` idempotency.
4. **VirusTotal Multi-Engine Scan**: 0/64 Clean across 64 engines.
5. **Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)**: Lightweight in-Sheets assistant drawer with offline `flows-bundle.json`, zero cell-data access, and zero analytics cookies.

## Complete Flow Catalog (12 Flows)

### B2B Client Invoice PDF Generator (`b2b-client-invoice`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=b2b-client-invoice
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/b2b-client-invoice
- **Category**: Document & PDF | **Difficulty**: Beginner | **Trigger**: Sheet Menu / Status Change | **Estimated Time Saved**: 6 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Docs, Drive
- **Summary**: Merge approved Google Sheets invoice rows into a branded Google Docs template, export PDFs to Drive, and log links back with LockService idempotency.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Invoices`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Invoice_ID | Client_Name | Client_Email | Service_Description | Amount_USD | Status | PDF_Link | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `INV-2026-104 | Acme Robotics Inc. | ap@acmerobotics.example | Q4 Cloud Automation Retainer | 4850.00 | Approved |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Create the Invoices tab with the required headers and paste your Google Docs template ID and Drive folder ID in SheetAutomate > Configure Template & Folder.
  2. Add {{Invoice_ID}}, {{Client_Name}}, {{Client_Email}}, {{Service_Description}}, {{Amount_USD}}, and {{Issue_Date}} placeholders to your Docs template.
  3. Mark ready rows as Approved in the Status column and run SheetAutomate > Generate Approved Invoice PDFs.

### Training & Course Certificate Batch Issuer (`completion-certificate-batch`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=completion-certificate-batch
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/completion-certificate-batch
- **Category**: HR & Team | **Difficulty**: Beginner | **Trigger**: Sheet Menu / Batch Run | **Estimated Time Saved**: 4 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Docs, Drive
- **Summary**: Batch-generate completion certificate PDFs for Approved trainees meeting the passing score, with LockService and existing-link duplicate prevention.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Certificates`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Certificate_ID | Trainee_Name | Course_Title | Score_Pct | Completion_Date | Status | PDF_Link | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `CERT-2026-881 | Jordan Alvarez | Workspace Security & Governance | 94 | 2026-11-10 | Approved |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Certificates Sheet to create the Certificates tab with required columns.
  2. Add {{Certificate_ID}}, {{Trainee_Name}}, {{Course_Title}}, {{Score_Pct}}, and {{Completion_Date}} placeholders to your Google Docs certificate template and save IDs + passing score via Configure.
  3. Ensure eligible rows have Status set to Approved and Score_Pct at or above the passing threshold, then run SheetAutomate > Issue Approved Certificate PDFs.

### Gmail Billing & Receipt Scanner to Sheets (`gmail-invoice-extractor`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=gmail-invoice-extractor
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/gmail-invoice-extractor
- **Category**: Email & Gmail | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Hourly Gmail Trigger | **Estimated Time Saved**: 4 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Gmail, Drive
- **Summary**: Scan Gmail threads matching a configurable billing query, archive PDF attachments to Drive, and log metadata to Sheets without duplicate message IDs.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Billing_Log`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Logged_At | Message_ID | Sender | Subject | Attachment_Name | Drive_PDF_Link | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `2026-11-12T09:15:00Z | 1930a4f8b2c1d9e0 | billing@cloudvendor.example | Invoice #CV-8841 - November Hosting | CV-8841.pdf | https://drive.google.com/file/d/example-cv-8841/view | COMPLETED`
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Billing_Log Sheet to create the log tab with required columns.
  2. Use SheetAutomate > Configure Gmail Query & Folder to customize your search filter (e.g. label:billing OR subject:invoice) and target Drive folder ID.
  3. Run SheetAutomate > Scan Gmail for PDF Invoices or click Install Hourly Trigger for hands-free archiving.

- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=hr-offer-letter-onboarding
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/hr-offer-letter-onboarding
- **Category**: HR & Team | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Sheet Menu / HR Batch Run | **Estimated Time Saved**: 6 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Docs, Drive
- **Summary**: Merge candidate details into a Google Docs offer template, create a dedicated Drive onboarding folder, export PDF, and log links idempotently.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Offers`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Candidate_ID | Candidate_Name | Role_Title | Start_Date | Base_Salary | Folder_Link | PDF_Link | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `CAND-2026-041 | Elena Vance | Senior Product Engineer | 2026-12-01 | $145,000 / yr |  |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Create an Offers tab matching the 8-column schema and enter candidate offer rows.
  2. Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
  3. Reload the Sheet, run SheetAutomate -> Create Starter Offer Template (or link your Doc ID), then run Generate Offer Packs.

### Low-Stock Threshold & Reorder Alert Dispatcher (`inventory-low-stock-alert`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=inventory-low-stock-alert
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/inventory-low-stock-alert
- **Category**: Alerts & Sync | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Hourly / Daily Check & Sheet Menu | **Estimated Time Saved**: 5 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Gmail, Chat/Webhook
- **Summary**: Monitor Stock_Qty against Reorder_Point, calculate suggested reorder quantities, and dispatch email digests plus optional webhook alerts.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Inventory`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `SKU | Item_Name | Stock_Qty | Reorder_Point | Target_Stock | Suggested_Reorder | Alert_Status | Last_Alert_Date`
- **Sample Row 1**: `SKU-1042 | Thermal Shipping Labels (Roll 1000) | 14 | 25 | 100 |  |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.send_mail`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.external_request`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Create an Inventory tab matching the 8-column schema and paste your SKU stock thresholds.
  2. Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save the project.
  3. Configure ALERT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL (and optional ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL) via the SheetAutomate menu, then run Check Stock Levels.

### Dynamic Multi-Row Sales Quote & Proposal PDF (`multi-item-sales-quote`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=multi-item-sales-quote
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/multi-item-sales-quote
- **Category**: Finance & Ops | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Sheet Menu / Batch Run | **Estimated Time Saved**: 6 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Docs, Drive
- **Summary**: Group multiple line-item rows sharing a Quote_ID in Google Sheets into a formatted multi-row table inside a Google Docs quote template and export as PDF.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Quote_Line_Items`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Quote_ID | Client_Name | Item_Description | Quantity | Unit_Price_USD | Status | PDF_Link | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `QT-2026-301 | Northstar Logistics | RFID Dock Scanner Hardware | 4 | 650.00 | Approved |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Run SheetAutomate > Initialize Quote_Line_Items Sheet to scaffold the multi-row line-item table.
  2. Add {{Quote_ID}}, {{Client_Name}}, {{Quote_Date}}, {{Grand_Total}}, and {{LINE_ITEMS_TABLE}} to your Google Docs quote template, then save Template & Folder IDs.
  3. Set Status to Approved across all line items for a Quote_ID and run SheetAutomate > Generate Multi-Item Quote PDFs.

### Automated Overdue Invoice Follow-Up Mailer (`overdue-payment-reminder`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=overdue-payment-reminder
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/overdue-payment-reminder
- **Category**: Email & Gmail | **Difficulty**: Beginner | **Trigger**: Daily Schedule / Sheet Menu | **Estimated Time Saved**: 4 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Gmail
- **Summary**: Daily scan of unpaid invoices comparing Due_Date to today and dispatching polite 3, 7, and 14+ day payment reminders once per stage.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Invoices`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Invoice_ID | Client_Name | Client_Email | Amount_Due | Due_Date | Payment_Status | Last_Reminder_Stage | Sent_Timestamp`
- **Sample Row 1**: `INV-2026-201 | Northstar Logistics Inc. | ap@northstar-example.com | 4850.00 | 2026-11-07 | UNPAID |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.send_mail`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Create or open a Google Sheet with an Invoices tab matching the 8-column schema and paste the sample data.
  2. Open Extensions -> Apps Script, replace Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save the project.
  3. Reload the Sheet, open the SheetAutomate menu, and run Install Daily Trigger or Send Overdue Reminders.

### Google Form Expense & Leave Approval Pipeline (`form-approval-workflow`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=form-approval-workflow
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/form-approval-workflow

- **Google Workspace Services**: Forms, Sheets, Gmail
- **Summary**: Process Google Form expense and leave requests in Sheets, enforce required approver notes, email decisions via MailApp, and lock timestamps.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Requests`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Request_ID | Requester_Email | Request_Type | Amount_Or_Days | Approval_Status | Approver_Notes | Decision_Timestamp | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `REQ-2026-501 | alex.rivera@example.com | Travel Expense | $420.00 | Approved | Approved under Q4 client travel budget. |  | `
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.send_mail`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Link your Google Form to a Sheet tab named Requests (or initialize headers matching the 8-column schema).
  2. Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
  3. Reload the Sheet, run SheetAutomate -> Install Form & Approval Triggers, then approve or reject requests via status or menu.

### Monthly Attendance & OT Sheet Provisioner + Auto-Lock (`monthly-ot-sheet-locker`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=monthly-ot-sheet-locker
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/monthly-ot-sheet-locker
- **Category**: HR & Team | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Monthly Schedule | **Estimated Time Saved**: 3 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets
- **Summary**: On the 1st of each month, clone _Template for the new month's OT tab with editable hour cells, lock the closing month's tab, and log to Audit_Log.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `_Template`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Employee_ID | Employee_Name | Department | Regular_Hours | OT_Hours | Manager_Approval | Audit_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `EMP-101 | Maya Chen | Field Engineering | 160 | 12.5 | Approved | READY`
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Run SheetAutomate > Initialize _Template & Audit_Log Tabs to scaffold the template sheet and audit log.
  2. Customize employee rows and formulas in _Template (columns D and E remain editable for staff hours).
  3. Run SheetAutomate > Provision Next Month & Lock Previous or click Install Monthly Trigger for the 1st of each month.

### Automated Weekly Executive KPI Digest Mailer (`weekly-kpi-digest-mailer`)
- **URL**: https://sheetautomate.com/?flow=weekly-kpi-digest-mailer
- **Source**: https://github.com/vuhung3990/sheetautomate.com/tree/main/flows/weekly-kpi-digest-mailer
- **Category**: Finance & Ops | **Difficulty**: Intermediate | **Trigger**: Weekly Monday Schedule / Menu | **Estimated Time Saved**: 4 hrs/wk
- **Google Workspace Services**: Sheets, Gmail
- **Summary**: Aggregate weekly revenue, cost, margin, and task completion KPIs across Sheets tabs, email a responsive HTML digest, and log run hashes.
- **Starter Sheet Tab**: `Weekly_KPI_Data`
- **Starter Sheet Headers**: `Week_Label | Department | Revenue | Cost | Tasks_Completed | Tasks_Planned | Row_Status`
- **Sample Row 1**: `2026-W46 | Enterprise Sales | 84500.00 | 29100.00 | 18 | 20 | READY`
- **Least-Privilege OAuth Scopes** (`appsscript.json`):
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.send_mail`
  - `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp`
- **60-Second Apps Script Setup Steps**:
  1. Create a Weekly_KPI_Data tab matching the 7-column schema (plus optional Tasks_Log tab) and add weekly department metrics.
  2. Open Extensions -> Apps Script, paste Code.gs and appsscript.json, and save.
  3. Configure STAKEHOLDER_EMAILS via SheetAutomate -> Configure Stakeholder Recipients, then run Send Weekly KPI Digest.


## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is SheetAutomate really 100% free with zero catch?
Yes. Every workflow in the catalog and the companion Chrome Extension are 100% free and open source under the MIT License. There are no subscriptions, credit cards, trial expirations, or per-document fees.

### How does adding a folder in flows/ auto-update the website and extension?
Each flow lives in its own self-contained folder under flows/<slug>/ containing flow.json, Code.gs, appsscript.json, thumbnail.svg, and README.md. When a Pull Request is merged on GitHub, Vite auto-discovers the folder at build time and GitHub Actions regenerates flows-manifest.json, the Chrome Extension bundle, and the security audit badges automatically.

### How does the Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) work inside Google Sheets?
The Chrome Extension renders a lightweight floating assistant drawer when you visit Google Sheets so you can search flows, copy Code.gs, and paste starter table headers in one click. It uses zero tracking, never reads or transmits your spreadsheet cell data, and ships with an offline-ready flows-bundle.json synced via GitHub Actions.

### How is every flow audited by the Community, AI, and VirusTotal?
First, all Code.gs scripts are published readable and unminified on GitHub for public review. Second, our CI pipeline checks every line for dangerous patterns and enforces minimum Google permissions (least-privilege OAuth scopes) plus duplicate-run protection (LockService). Third, release bundles are scanned across 60+ security engines on VirusTotal with 0 detections.

### Does any spreadsheet or customer data leave my Google Workspace?
Never. SheetAutomate does not run any backend server or database. All scripts execute privately inside Google Apps Script under your own Google Account, moving data directly between your Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Gmail.

### Why does Google show "Google hasn’t verified this app" the first time I run a script?
That screen is completely normal when you paste your own Apps Script into a Google Sheet. Google shows it for any personal script that has not been submitted to the public Google Workspace Marketplace. You are only authorizing yourself to run your own copy inside your Google Drive — SheetAutomate never sees your data or credentials. Simply click Advanced → Go to [project name] (unsafe) once to continue, and you can inspect, delete the script, or revoke access anytime in your Google Account permissions.

### Are there any limits on how many documents or emails I can automate?
SheetAutomate imposes zero artificial caps. You are only governed by Google Workspace’s standard daily Apps Script quotas (such as 1,500 document creations/day and 6-minute batch execution windows).

### Can I customize or use SheetAutomate for commercial client projects?
Yes! Under the permissive MIT License, you can freely modify the Code.gs scripts, swap Google Doc templates, add custom webhooks in Script Properties, and deploy them for internal teams or commercial client engagements.
